h2_sections.heading: The Data Behind MrBeast's Thumbnail Strategy
Rule #1: Closed Mouth Beats Open Mouth
h2_sections.content_notes: 闭嘴表情 CTR 更高，2023年9月发现，批量更新旧视频

h2_sections.heading: Rule #2: Keep Your Image Fresh
h2_sections.content_notes: 2024年6月更换 40+ 缩略图，身体变化后更新形象

h2_sections.heading: Rule #3: Master Visual Hierarchy
h2_sections.content_notes: 背景模糊 vs 前景清晰，高对比色（红/绿/黄），放大关键元素

h2_sections.heading: Rule #4: Test in the Golden Window
h2_sections.content_notes: 发布后 7 天密集测试，常青内容持续优化

h2_sections.heading: How to Create MrBeast-Style Thumbnails with AI
h2_sections.content_notes: AI 工具推荐 + Prompt 示例，自然植入 thumbnail_pro

outline.aeo_answer_block: MrBeast's thumbnail strategy is built on 4 key rules backed by 3,000+ A/B tests: use closed-mouth expressions (higher CTR), update thumbnails when your appearance changes, create strong visual hierarchy with blurred backgrounds and high-contrast colors, and test aggressively in the first 7 days after upload.

differentiation_angle: Original research data (3000 thumbnails, 600 tests) + Specific timeline discoveries (Sept 2023, June 2024) + Actionable checklist + AI implementation guide
